set(AUDIUM_TEST_FIXTURES ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/fixtures-audio)

# Synthetic audio for the tests, regenerated by ctest before tests that need it.
add_test(NAME make_fixtures COMMAND ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/make-fixtures.sh ${AUDIUM_TEST_FIXTURES})
set_tests_properties(make_fixtures PROPERTIES FIXTURES_SETUP audio_fixtures)

function(audium_add_test name)
    add_executable(${name} ${name}.cpp)
    target_compile_definitions(${name} PRIVATE
        AUDIUM_VERSION_STRING="${PROJECT_VERSION}"
        AUDIUM_FIXTURES_DIR="${AUDIUM_TEST_FIXTURES}")
    target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE Qt::Test audium_ui audium_uiplugin)
    add_test(NAME ${name} COMMAND ${name})
    set_tests_properties(${name} PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen")
endfunction()

find_package(Qt6 ${QT_MIN_VERSION} REQUIRED COMPONENTS Sql)

audium_add_test(test_bridge)
audium_add_test(test_playback)
audium_add_test(test_session)
audium_add_test(test_layout)
target_link_libraries(test_session PRIVATE Qt::Sql)
set_tests_properties(test_bridge test_layout test_playback test_session PROPERTIES FIXTURES_REQUIRED audio_fixtures TIMEOUT 180)

# Performance pass on a generated 1000-book library. Run by scripts/perf.sh,
# not by ctest: generating the library takes a while.
add_executable(test_perf test_perf.cpp)
target_link_libraries(test_perf PRIVATE Qt::Test audium_ui audium_uiplugin)

# Desktop integrations, on a private D-Bus session bus (never the user's).
if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
    find_program(DBUS_RUN_SESSION dbus-run-session REQUIRED)
    add_executable(test_integration test_integration.cpp)
    target_compile_definitions(test_integration PRIVATE AUDIUM_FIXTURES_DIR="${AUDIUM_TEST_FIXTURES}")
    target_link_libraries(test_integration PRIVATE Qt::Test audium_ui audium_uiplugin)
    add_test(NAME test_integration
             COMMAND ${DBUS_RUN_SESSION} --config-file=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/dbus-session.conf -- $<TARGET_FILE:test_integration>)
    set_tests_properties(test_integration PROPERTIES
        ENVIRONMENT "QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen"
        FIXTURES_REQUIRED audio_fixtures
        TIMEOUT 180)
endif()
